title: Monotonicity of bounded acceptance
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over Boolean strings, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $x$ be an input. If some choice sequence of length $t$ makes the machine halt with output $[\mathrm{true}]$, then for every $t' \ge t$ some choice sequence of length $t'$ does so as well.
hypotheses_covered: finite-state nondeterministic oracle machine over Booleans
